status_note: Proposed record for the development line after 5.1.0-alpha.1, which retired Classic (bytefray-rules-4) and made Active Sensing the only Ruleset. The application version is a placeholder: docs/COMPONENT_VERSIONING.md section 4.1 classes removing an executable stable Ruleset and changing the default Ruleset as MAJOR, and the project lead decides the release number. Nothing on this line is qualified for release.

python_policy.qualification_note: Support tiers are the approved CI policy; current run results and release qualification are recorded separately.

offered.selection: the only Ruleset; used when no Ruleset is chosen

research_only.selection: `bytefray agents evaluate --ruleset <exact id>` or the Python API
research_only.promise: Research reproduction only. Not a product feature; no stability or compatibility promise.

application.name: Bytefray Spectator
application.release_status: the build bundled with the 5.1.0-alpha.1 Windows installer; unchanged on this line
application.distribution: pinned by `tools/spectator_companion.json`, as in 5.1.0-alpha.1. `BYTEFRAY_SPECTATOR` overrides it or turns Spectator off. Source and wheel installs find Spectator through `BYTEFRAY_SPECTATOR`, `<data root>/spectator/` or `bytefray-spectator` on `PATH`

platforms.bytefray: Primary target. Automated suites pass on this line; not release-qualified.
Headless-first wheel. Not qualified on this line.

limitations: Active Sensing (Alpha) is the only Ruleset. Classic (`bytefray-rules-4`) is retired: a request for it is rejected as retired, never remapped. Bytefray 5.1.0-alpha.1 still runs Classic.
Active Sensing requires an arena larger than 64 cells.

The bundled starter agents are the three Active Sensing starters (Window Scout, Watchful Keeper, Roaming Reacquirer). The V4 and V5 starters are no longer installed; copies already in a data folder are left alone and still run, but their passive contact finding never engages under Active Sensing.
Bytefray Spectator presents only completed two-entrant (A, B) matches; every other match opens in the Pygame viewer.
The Pygame viewer's passive Director, Fight Night and perspective modes apply only to historical and research replays; Active Sensing replays use the Agent A, Agent B and Omniscient views.
unsupported: New Classic (`bytefray-rules-4`) matches, development tests, evaluations or tournaments.
Executing Agent API v1 agents, VM/blob agents or Redcode/pMARS warriors; their recorded artifacts stay readable.
New matches under the historical Rulesets listed as readable but not executable. The two retired research Rulesets remain executable for research reproduction only.
Spectator for three-entrant matches, tournaments or Replay History launches.
